    • Method Detail

      • getPostBuildVariantSiblings

        @PublishedMethod
<T extends MIObject> java.util.Collection<T> getPostBuildVariantSiblings(T obj)
        This method returns MDF object instances representing the same object but in all variants. The collection returned contains the object itself including all siblings from other PostBuild variants. The calculation of siblings depends on the object-type as follows:
        • Ecuc Module Configuration:
          Since module configurations are never variant, this method always returns a collection which contains the specified object only
        • Ecuc Container:
          For siblings of a container all of the following conditions apply:
          • They have the same AUTOSAR path
          • They have the same definition path (containers with the same AUTOSAR path but different definitions may occur in variant models - but they are not variant siblings because they differ in type)
        • Ecuc Parameter:
          For siblings of a parameter all of the following conditions apply:
          • The parent containers have the same AUTOSAR path
          • The parameter siblings have the same definition path
          The parameter values are not relevant so parameter siblings may have different values.
          Multi-instance parameters are special. In this case the method returns all multi-instance siblings of all variants.
        • System description object:
          For siblings of MIReferrables all of the following conditions apply:
          • They have the same meta-class
          • They have the same AUTOSAR path
          For siblings of non-MIReferrables all of the following conditions apply:
          • Their nearest MIReferrable-parents are either the same object or variant siblings
          • Their containment feature paths below these nearest MIReferrable-parents is equal

        Special use cases: When the specified object is not a member of the model tree (the object itself or one of its parents has no parent), it also has no siblings. In this case this method returns a collection containing the specified object only.

        Remark concerning visibility: This method returns all siblings independent of the currently visible objects. This means that the returned collection probably contains objects which are not visible by the caller! It also means that the specified object itself doesn't need to be visible for the caller.

        Note: This method is IModelView aware, which means the result depends on the activated IPreBuildView, or the IUnfilteredView.

        Parameters:
        obj -
        Returns:
        The found siblings or an empty collection if the specified object is null or deleted.

      • getPreAndPostBuildVariantSiblings

        @KeepSecretFromPublishedApi
<T extends MIObject> java.util.Collection<T> getPreAndPostBuildVariantSiblings(T obj)
        This method returns MDF object instances representing the same object but in all variants. The collection returned contains the object itself including all siblings from other PreBuild and PostBuild variants. The calculation of siblings depends on the object-type as follows:
        • Ecuc Module Configuration:
          Since module configurations are never variant, this method always returns a collection which contains the specified object only
        • Ecuc Container:
          For siblings of a container all of the following conditions apply:
          • They have the same AUTOSAR path
          • They have the same definition path (containers with the same AUTOSAR path but different definitions may occur in variant models - but they are not variant siblings because they differ in type)
        • Ecuc Parameter:
          For siblings of a parameter all of the following conditions apply:
          • The parent containers have the same AUTOSAR path
          • The parameter siblings have the same definition path
          The parameter values are not relevant so parameter siblings may have different values.
          Multi-instance parameters are special. In this case the method returns all multi-instance siblings of all variants.
        • System description object:
          For siblings of MIReferrables all of the following conditions apply:
          • They have the same meta-class
          • They have the same AUTOSAR path
          For siblings of non-MIReferrables all of the following conditions apply:
          • Their nearest MIReferrable-parents are either the same object or variant siblings
          • Their containment feature paths below these nearest MIReferrable-parents is equal

        Special use cases: When the specified object is not a member of the model tree (the object itself or one of its parents has no parent), it also has no siblings. In this case this method returns a collection containing the specified object only.

        Remark concerning visibility: This method returns all siblings independent of the currently visible objects. This means that the returned collection probably contains objects which are not visible by the caller! It also means that the specified object itself doesn't need to be visible for the caller.

        This method also includes the result of the PostBuild variance, so the returned list will always contain the content of getPostBuildVariantSiblings(MIObject) + PreBuild variance.

        Parameters:
        obj -
        Returns:
        The found siblings or an empty collection if the specified object is null or deleted.

      • getVariantSiblingsInModelView

        @PublishedMethod
<T extends MIObject> java.util.Collection<T> getVariantSiblingsInModelView(T obj,
                                                                                             IModelView view)
        Returns the variant siblings which are visible in the specified model view. The sibling semantic is the same as described in getPostBuildVariantSiblings(MIObject).

        Note: if the passed IModelView is an instance of IPostBuildView, the used method is getPreAndPostBuildVariantSiblings(MIObject).

        Parameters:
        obj -
        view - the IModelView for check for siblings.
        Returns:
        The found siblings or an empty collection if no sibling was found

      • getVariantSiblingsInModelViewWithoutMyself

        @PublishedMethod
<T extends MIObject> java.util.Collection<T> getVariantSiblingsInModelViewWithoutMyself(T obj,
                                                                                                          IModelView view)
        Returns the same collection as getVariantSiblingsInModelView(MIObject, IModelView) but without the specified object.

        Note: if the passed IModelView is an instance of IPostBuildView, the used method is getPreAndPostBuildVariantSiblings(MIObject).

        Parameters:
        obj -
        view - the IModelView for check for siblings.
        Returns:
        The found siblings or an empty collection if no sibling was found
